id: -339-腓力二世對希臘的戰爭（第四次神聖戰爭）
theater: 希臘中部玻俄提亞的喀羅尼亞平原

battle.name: 腓力二世對希臘的戰爭（第四次神聖戰爭）
battle.theater: 希臘中部玻俄提亞的喀羅尼亞平原
battle.brief: 前339至前338年，馬其頓王腓力二世以安菲克提翁裁決為由攻入希臘，攻陷阿莫菲薩，逼底比斯與雅典結盟。前338年9月7日，兩軍戰於玻俄提亞喀羅尼亞平原，腓力以密集方陣與伴侶騎兵擊潰底比斯聖隊與聯軍，迫使各邦加入科林斯聯盟；亞述式合成弓由色雷斯弓手用於兩翼遮蔽。

kit.name: 亞述長弓
kit.history: 亞述人靠弓和鐵的組合征服兩河流域。弓兵在車上射，車兵靠弓兵開路。

countries: 第四次神聖戰爭（公元前339至前338年）實質是馬其頓王國對希臘城邦聯盟的一場王國戰爭，形式上卻以安菲克提翁同盟宣布「神聖戰爭」的名義展開。馬其頓方面由腓力二世直接統率的王國常備軍為核心：密集方陣（hetairoi phalanx）以薩里沙長矛為骨幹，輔以佩加索斯精兵（hypaspites）、伴侶騎兵（Companion cavalry）與各色輕兵；盟友則有前339年帖薩利亞戰役後倒向馬其頓的帖薩利亞聯盟騎兵，以及伊利里亞、色雷斯的散兵與弓手。希臘方面是前338年因恐懼而形成的反馬其頓聯盟：以底比斯為首的玻俄提亞聯盟（由十一名玻俄塔爾執政官與一名軍政官主持）、雅典民主邦（五百人議事會與十將軍制）、麥加拉與其他小邦的僱傭兵。裁判機關安菲克提翁議會在前339年宣布對腓力開戰，等於把一場國與國的戰爭翻譯成神聖裁決。背景還有波斯王阿爾達薛斯三世在東方的觀望，以及斯巴達長期希望削弱底比斯而對馬其頓行動抱持的容忍。
countriesEn: The Fourth Sacred War of 339-338 BC was in substance a war between the kingdom of Macedon and an alliance of Greek poleis, even though it was fought in the name of a sacred war declared by the Amphictyonic League. On the Macedonian side the core was the standing royal army personally commanded by Philip II: the dense phalanx (hetairoi phalanx) built on the sarissa, supported by the hypaspits as bodyguard infantry, the Companion cavalry, and a mixture of light troops; among the allies were the Thessalian League cavalry, which had swung to Macedon after the campaign in Thessaly in 339 BC, together with Illyrian and Thracian peltasts and archers. On the Greek side stood an anti-Macedonian coalition assembled in 338 BC out of sheer fear: the Boeotian League led by Thebes, governed by eleven Boeotarchs and a polemarch; the Athenian democracy with its Council of Five Hundred and its board of ten strategoi; and the mercenaries of Megara and the smaller poleis. The Amphictyonic council declared war on Philip in 339 BC, which translated a war between states into a sacred adjudication. In the background sat the watchful king of Persia, Artaxerxes III, in the east, and the Spartan willingness to let Macedon act, since Sparta had long wanted Thebes weakened.
people: 腓力二世（前359至前336年在位）是全場唯一的主導者。他少年時曾被送往底比斯做人質（前367至前364年），親眼見證埃帕米農達斯推行的方陣與輕步兵改革，這段經歷被後世視為馬其頓密集隊形與攻城戰術的源頭。前338年9月7日喀羅尼亞之戰時，他同時是國王、統帥與外交家：陣前以右翼親率主力，誘使希臘騎兵追擊反噬，戰後以書函與聯盟條款鞏固戰果。十八歲的亞歷山大三世被派守左翼，指揮最精銳的方陣營與伴侶騎兵，衝鋒擊潰底比斯聖隊，藉此取得接班資本。底比斯的實際統兵者已非埃帕米農達斯（他早在前362年曼提涅亞陣亡），而是其門徒與聖隊餘部；雅典方面由德摩斯提尼領銜，他以「警告者」姿態力主抵抗，並在演說中援引腓力昔年在底比斯的舊誼與今日的威脅作對比，克塞諾豐與呂庫爾戈斯則負責外交游說與軍費籌措。帖薩利亞聯盟的領袖、安菲克提翁議會的代表、前338年向各邦散發腓力書信的使者，以及隨軍的工程人員、醫護與攻城技師，都是這場戰爭裡真正做事的人。
peopleEn: Philip II (reigned 359-336 BC) was the only man who really directed the war. Sent to Thebes as a hostage in his youth (367-364 BC), he had watched Epaminondas reorganise the phalanx and the light infantry at first hand, and later tradition made that stay the fountainhead of the Macedonian phalanx and of its siegecraft. On 7 September 338 BC at Chaeronea he was simultaneously king, commander and diplomat: in the battle he led the right wing in person and drew the Greek cavalry into a pursuit that turned back on itself, and afterwards he secured his conquest with letters and with the terms of the league. Alexander III, only eighteen years old, was given the left wing with the finest contingent of the phalanx and the Companion cavalry, charged the Theban Sacred Band, and thereby earned his inheritance of the command. The Theban army was no longer led by Epaminondas himself, who had fallen at Mantinea as early as 362 BC, but by his pupils and the surviving remnant of the Sacred Band. At Athens Demosthenes took the lead, pressing for resistance in the manner of the orator who warns, and setting Philip's old friendship with Thebes against his present threat in his speeches, while Xenophon and Lycurgus handled the lobbying and the money. The leaders of the Thessalian League, the envoys of the Amphictyonic council, the messengers who carried Philip's letters to the cities in 338 BC, together with the engineers, surgeons and siege technicians who marched with the army, were the men who actually made this war work.
kits: 本卡兵器是亞述長弓，即角—木—角三層貼合、上弦後呈角狀反曲的合成短弓，流行於亞述與波斯體系，形制上已是後來「斯基泰弓」的先聲。亞述人靠弓與鐵的組合征服兩河流域，弓兵在車上射，車兵靠弓兵開路：這是把射擊技術直接編入機動打法的體系。希臘本土步兵傳統以長矛與重甲為核心，弓只作輔助；前339至前338年的戰役中真正握弓的是外來與邊疆輕兵——色雷斯與伊利里亞弓手、克里特與羅德島弓手、以及歸附的帖薩利亞騎兵，其短反曲弓正屬亞述—波斯一系。其他裝備包括薩里沙長矛（最長約六米）、重裝步兵的青銅胸甲與頭盔、hoplon 圓盾（底比斯所用樣式更接近馬其頓的輕裝圓盾）、標槍（pilum）、投石索與皮爾夫重投矛、鱗甲與鎧甲、撞錘、攻城塔樓，以及配重式與扭力式弩炮（介於阿投射器與石弩之間），另有三列槍戰船與運兵船隊，用於在科林斯灣的兩棲威脅。值得留意的是，這場戰爭同時是馬其頓方陣成熟與希臘城邦僱傭兵體系崩解的交叉點：弓的戰術位置正從輔助退向兩翼的遮蔽與騷擾。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the Assyrian bow: a short composite bow of horn, wood and horn, laminated in three layers and pulling into an angular recurve once strung, native to the Assyrian and Persian system and in form the ancestor of the later Scythian bow. The Assyrians conquered Mesopotamia through the combination of the bow and iron, their archers shooting from the chariot while the charioteers advanced behind the archers' work: a system that folded shooting technique straight into manoeuvre. Greek infantry tradition rested on the spear and heavy armour, with the bow in a supporting role, and in the campaigns of 339-338 BC those who actually held a bow were foreign and frontier light troops - Thracian and Illyrian archers, Cretan and Rhodian archers, and the Thessalian horse that had come over to Philip - all using short recurved bows of the Assyrian-Persian family. The rest of the equipment included the sarissa, at its longest some six metres, the bronze cuirasses and helmets of the heavy infantry, hoplon shields (Theban examples ran closer to the lighter Macedonian pattern), the pilum, slings and javelins, scale and mail armour, rams, siege towers, and both counterweight and torsion artillery standing between the arrow-shooting gastrētēs and the stone-throwing catapult; there were also triremes and troop transports, used to threaten across the Gulf of Corinth. What matters is that this war is the point where the Macedonian phalanx matured and the Greek polis system of mercenary armies came apart: the bow's tactical position was retreating from an auxiliary role toward screening and harrying on the flanks.
tactics: 喀羅尼亞的部署是全戰役的樣板。馬其頓以密集方陣為中央，腓力自領右翼與方陣主力，亞歷山大領左翼，配最精銳的方陣營與伴侶騎兵，帖薩利亞騎兵置於一翼；希臘聯軍則以底比斯重裝步兵居中，聖隊與底比斯騎兵在左翼，雅典與其他邦的步兵填在兩翼。交戰前腓力在中央留出缺口把敵軍引入，再以方陣的斜向推進（後世稱為「斜陣」）使希臘聯軍的某一翼失去遮蔽，陣形一旦被拉開即遭側翼捲入；亞歷山大同時以左翼主動衝鋒，正面吃掉底比斯聖隊的抵抗。戰術要點有三：方陣靠長矛密度而非單兵武藝取勝；騎兵必須插入敵陣已被拉開的缺口；弓手與散兵在兩翼遮蔽，使正面進攻時不致遭側翼射擊。戰役前段是運動戰與政治戰：前339年腓力取溫泉關、進軍帖薩利亞，在貢諾伊一役以密集楔形騎兵陣取勝，再占據厄拉提亞，逼得雅典議會連夜集合，最後以聯盟條款與軍事壓力合併兩條戰線。
tacticsEn: The deployment at Chaeronea is the model for the whole war. Macedon put the dense phalanx in the centre, Philip took the right wing together with the bulk of the phalanx, and Alexander was given the left wing with the finest contingent of the phalanx and the Companion cavalry, while the Thessalian horse was posted on one flank; on the Greek side the Theban heavy infantry occupied the centre, the Sacred Band and the Theban cavalry the left wing, and the Athenians and the other allies' infantry filled the wings. Before contact Philip opened a gap in the centre to draw the enemy in, then advanced his phalanx obliquely - later called the oblique order - so that one wing of the Greek line lost its cover and, once stretched, was rolled up from the flank; at the same time Alexander charged forward with the left wing and broke the resistance of the Theban Sacred Band head on. There are three tactical points: the phalanx won through density of spears rather than individual valour; the cavalry had to be fed into the gap opened by the enemy's own extension; and the archers and peltasts screened the flanks so that a frontal attack would not be shot in the flank. The earlier phase was a war of manoeuvre and of politics: in 339 BC Philip took Thermopylae, campaigned into Thessaly, won at Gonnoi with a tight wedge of horsemen, and seized Elatea, which forced the Athenian council to sit through the night and drove him to combine two fronts - league terms on one side, military pressure on the other.
data: 史料以狄奧多羅斯《古典史》第十六卷最詳細，其記數與後世估算略有出入。前339年腓力占據厄拉提亞時，狄奧多羅斯記其步兵二萬、騎兵三千；前338年喀羅尼亞決戰時記馬其頓步兵三萬、騎兵三千，其中帖薩利亞騎兵約二千。希臘聯軍方面：底比斯重裝步兵約六千、騎兵一千（聖隊三百人編入其中），雅典步兵二千、騎兵三百，麥加拉步兵約一千，其餘各邦合計約三千。傷亡：底比斯陣亡約一千、被俘約二千；雅典陣亡約七百、被俘約一千；普魯塔克《十講辭士傳》記聖隊三百人中二百五十三人陣亡，僅三十七人生還。全場聯軍損失約三千人，馬其頓一方相對輕微。城市距離也是關鍵數字：喀羅尼亞距雅典約六十公里，距馬其頓本土約二百五十公里，腓力自前339年春入希臘到前338年9月決戰，前後不足一年。前338年雅典議會曾決議出兵一萬步兵、一千騎兵，並派二百艘三列槍戰船前往科林斯灣，說明雅典計劃中的遠征軍規模遠大於實際投入喀羅尼亞的兩千人。
dataEn: Diodorus Siculus, Book Sixteen of the Bibliotheca Historica, is the fullest source and his figures differ somewhat from later reconstructions. When Philip occupied Elatea in 339 BC, Diodorus gives him twenty thousand foot and three thousand horse; for the decisive battle at Chaeronea in 338 BC he gives Macedon thirty thousand foot and three thousand horse, of whom about two thousand were Thessalian cavalry. On the Greek side the figures are: Thebes with about six thousand heavy infantry and a thousand horse, the Sacred Band of three hundred being counted among them; Athens with two thousand foot and three hundred horse; Megara with about a thousand foot; and roughly three thousand foot from the remaining allies. Losses: about a thousand Thebans killed and two thousand captured; about seven hundred Athenians killed and a thousand captured; Plutarch's Lives of the Ten Orators records that of the three hundred of the Sacred Band, two hundred and fifty-three fell and only thirty-seven survived. The coalition as a whole lost some three thousand men, while Macedon's own losses were comparatively light. Distances matter as much as numbers: Chaeronea lies about sixty kilometres from Athens and roughly two hundred and fifty from Macedonia proper, and less than a year separates Philip's entry into Greece in the spring of 339 from the decisive battle in September 338. The Athenian assembly in 338 BC had voted to send ten thousand infantry, a thousand cavalry and two hundred triremes to the Gulf of Corinth, which shows how much larger the planned Athenian expedition was than the two thousand men actually committed at Chaeronea.
cause: 導火線有三層。第一層是前356至前346年第三次神聖戰爭的遺產：腓力靠干預福基斯戰爭而取得安菲克提翁議會的席位與福基斯的投票權，等於握住了裁決希臘城邦的鑰匙，卻也讓聯盟內部怨氣累積。第二層是前339年洛基里人拒絕執行安菲克提翁議會對阿莫菲薩的罰款與駐軍要求，腓力以此為由出兵、攻陷阿莫菲薩；議會隨即宣布對腓力發動「神聖戰爭」，並把指揮權交給帖薩利亞。第三層是帖薩利亞向雅典求援，雅典在一片恐慌中與底比斯結盟——理由並非援助友邦，而是無法接受一個馬其頓人主宰泛希臘事務；德摩斯提尼的演說把這層恐懼推到了檯面上。至於腓力的戰略目標，更為冷靜：東征波斯之前必須先消除希臘本土的反對力量與安菲克提翁的干預能力，他不需要征服希臘，只需要希臘保持安靜並承認他的霸權。
causeEn: The outbreak had three layers. The first was the legacy of the Third Sacred War of 356-346 BC: by intervening in the Phocian War, Philip had won seats on the Amphictyonic council and the Phocian vote, which gave him the key to the adjudication of the Greek poleis even as resentment accumulated inside the league. The second was that in 339 BC the Locrians refused to carry out the fine and the garrisoning of troops that the Amphictyonic council had imposed on Amphissa; Philip marched on that pretext and took the city, whereupon the council declared a sacred war against him and handed the command of it to Thessaly. The third was Thessaly's appeal to Athens, and Athens' alliance with Thebes in a climate of panic - the motive being less the defence of an ally than the plain unwillingness to let a Macedonian preside over the affairs of all Greece, a fear Demosthenes placed in the open in his speeches. Philip's own strategic purpose was colder still: before marching east against Persia he had to remove the opposition in Greece and the Amphictyonic power of interference; he did not need to conquer Greece, only to keep it quiet and to have it acknowledge his hegemony.
impact: 這場戰爭結束了古典希臘城邦政治的前提。以底比斯為首的玻俄提亞聯盟被解散，底比斯城邦遭到拆解，其住民被擄為奴隸，城牆與城邦制度一併抹去；雅典失去部分城邦領土，長城被拆，但保留了民主形式，作為交換加入腓力主導的科林斯聯盟。此後希臘城邦在名目上仍是自由邦，實際上受馬其頓總督與駐軍控制；腓力於前337年召集科林斯大會，宣布共同和平與對波斯的戰爭，開啟東征的準備，也把自己擺在希臘世界唯一盟主的位置。這場戰爭同時改變了希臘的兵制：重裝步兵方陣與騎兵團的組合被證明優於各城邦自募的民兵，職業化與中央化的軍隊成為往後的標準，軍中的「以弗所兵」那樣的外來兵員也逐漸被本國常備軍取代。希臘將領與僱傭兵大批東流，亞洲戰場從此吸走希臘的軍事人口；腓力本人於前336年遇刺身亡，但由這場戰爭奠定的格局，反而讓亞歷山大得以在十年內接管同一個希臘，並把遠征的隊伍組成方式直接沿用。
impactEn: This war ended the premises of classical Greek polis politics. The Boeotian League led by Thebes was dissolved; the Theban polis was broken up, its inhabitants carried off into slavery, its walls and its civic institutions erased; Athens lost some of its territory and had its Long Walls demolished, but kept the form of its democracy in exchange for admission to Philip's League of Corinth. Thereafter the Greek cities were free in name only, in practice subject to Macedonian governors and garrisons; in 337 BC Philip gathered the congress at Corinth, proclaimed a common peace and a war against Persia, and prepared the expedition east, placing himself as the single hegemon of the Greek world. The war changed Greek military practice as well: the combination of the heavy infantry phalanx and the cavalry was shown to be superior to the citizen militias of the individual cities, and the professional, centrally controlled army became the standard thereafter, gradually displacing the hired contingents such as the Ephesians that had served in the phalanx. Greek commanders and mercenaries moved east in numbers, and the Asian campaigns drained the military manpower of Greece. Philip himself was assassinated in 336 BC, but the structure this war established was precisely what allowed Alexander to inherit the same Greece within a decade and to carry the composition of his expeditionary army over unchanged.
result: 結果是馬其頓完勝。前338年9月7日之後，玻俄提亞聯盟解體，底比斯交出城市並被課以罰款，其聖隊作為一支獨立的精兵單位就此消失，殘餘成員被分別編入各邦的軍隊；雅典接受苛刻條件——失去部分土地、長城被拆、承認馬其頓的保護並加入科林斯聯盟，民主在受監督的形式下得以保留。第四神聖戰爭在希臘史書中常被視為短促而關鍵的一役：它沒有在安菲克提翁的框架內解決爭端，而是以一次會戰改寫了整個半島的權力結構。腓力以此為跳板，前337年組成泛希臘聯盟，前336年宣布東征波斯；希臘人的城邦自由自此成為有名無實的體面，腓力二世的帝國則在形式上仍由希臘城邦的表面自治包裹起來，直到這套體系隨著他的死亡而崩解。
resultEn: The result was a complete Macedonian victory. After 7 September 338 BC the Boeotian League was dissolved; Thebes surrendered its city and was fined, and the Sacred Band ceased to exist as an independent body of picked troops, its survivors being distributed among the armies of the separate cities; Athens accepted harsh terms - the loss of territory, the demolition of the Long Walls, recognition of Macedonian protection, and entry into the League of Corinth - with its democracy preserved in a supervised form. Greek historians have often treated the Fourth Sacred War as a short but decisive campaign: it was not settled inside the framework of the Amphictyonic league, but by a single battle that rewrote the power structure of the whole peninsula. Philip used it as a springboard, forming the pan-Hellenic league in 337 BC and declaring the war against Persia in 336. From that point the freedom of the Greek city-states was a hollow form, and Philip's empire remained, in outward shape, wrapped in the superficial autonomy of Greek cities, until the whole system collapsed with his death.
